# Yaseen Ahmad (yaseenahmadexe)

> Yaseen Ahmad (online as yaseenahmadexe) is a freelance full-stack developer and final-year BS Software Engineering student at CECOS University in Peshawar, Pakistan. This site is his portfolio: selected projects with details, screenshots and links to public source code. Available for work.

Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma, Docker, Vercel.
Services: web apps, business and portfolio sites, dashboards and admin panels, REST APIs, responsive UI.
Repository listings on the portfolio do not imply sole authorship of every project.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app): Portfolio, selected projects, journey, toolkit and contact details
- [Software engineering project enquiries](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/freelance-software-engineer): Freelance services overview
- [Web developer in Peshawar](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/hire-web-developer-peshawar): Local web development services
- [React, Node.js and full-stack development](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/mern-stack-developer): Full-stack services
- [CECOS QEC Portal case study](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/cecos-qec-portal): Case study of the university QEC website
- [Uncensored LLM](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/uncensored-llm): Project page for a free uncensored LLM chat and its open-source Kaggle GPU server
- [CV (PDF)](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app/Yaseen-Ahmad-CV.pdf): Curriculum vitae

## Projects

- [FoodHub](https://yaseenahmadexe.vercel.app): Food-ordering marketplace for Peshawar. Flutter (Android and web), TypeScript API on Neon Postgres. Source private.
- [CECOS QEC Portal](https://qec-page.vercel.app/qec): Quality Enhancement Cell website for CECOS University Peshawar. Next.js and Supabase on Vercel. Source private.
- [AI Clinic Receptionist](https://github.com/MrYaseen0/ai-clinic-receptionist): Open-source bilingual (English and Roman Urdu) clinic booking assistant. Live demo: https://ai-clinic-receptionist-gold.vercel.app/
- [PropEase](https://github.com/MrYaseen0/PropEasy-An-Property-management-system): Property management web app. Repository access may require permission. Live app (sign-in required): https://propease-pi.vercel.app/
- [Bitanas Salon](https://github.com/MrYaseen0/-Bitanas-Salon-Peshawar): Salon website with booking UI, price calculator and loyalty features
- [Game Booster](https://github.com/MrYaseen0/game-booster): Android game-mode app for PUBG Mobile
- [GitNova](https://github.com/MrYaseen0/gitnova): Gamified Git and programming learning platform
- [XAU Bot](https://github.com/MrYaseen0/xau-bot): Gold trading dashboard, educational paper trading only
- [YTUBE](https://github.com/MrYaseen0/ytube): YouTube-style full-stack app (Next.js 14, Supabase)
- [System Design Reference](https://github.com/MrYaseen0/system-design-reference): System design interview reference notes
- [Face Recognition Attendance](https://github.com/MrYaseen0/face-recognition-attendance-system): Attendance system using computer vision
